osm.qualification: Versioned public subset of the retrieved OSM snapshot. River, woodland/grass and paths relevant to the study; no provider pixels or credentials.

qualification: Campus-side component west of the OSM Garchinger Mühlbach, within a bounded central-campus study. River boundary is mapped; north/south study limits are not claimed as physical woodland edges. DGM1 ground and DOM20/DOP20 canopy. Preserve older ground/trees, existing building footprints and water. Tree species, branches, path widths without tags and soil cover are estimates. Inferred trunks are excluded from mapped path corridors with an additional0.35m allowance.
